prompts.coat:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: seamless painted albedo texture for the gray-brown coat of a Wolfos enemy in an Ocarina of Time styled game remaster. Opaque rectangular texture, 1:2 width-to-height ratio.
Create only the FLAT FUR TEXTURE, edge to edge. Image 1 is the original tiny native fur map used as a texture placement/style guide, and image 2 shows the character with its new amber eyes as style context. Do not render a character, face, animal, swatch scene, or illustration. This is a reusable UV texture.
Paint a dense short wolf coat: slim fine directional hairs flowing DOWNWARD, layered soft pointed tufts that taper gently, irregular subtle overlapping fur groupings. Main tone muted warm gray and taupe, with medium umber roots and restrained pale buff tips. Cool gray within the shadows. Values generally midtone, not white. Fur should have nuanced strand detail that reads at 512px without looking noisy. Preserve the original's idea of dark roots and lighter pointed strands but greatly improve the definition and organic variation.
Style: polished hand-painted game texture compatible with classic Zelda aesthetics; controlled painterly forms, supple tapered hairs, restrained organic texture. Avoid the old chunky plate or scale appearance: no massive clumps, no hard zigzag bands, no pyramids, no carved stone shapes, no leaves, no feathers, no repetitive large chevrons. Not photorealistic. No baked directional lighting, specular shine or cast shadows.
The texture tiles seamlessly on ALL edges with continuous scale, color and fur flow. Downward fur orientation throughout. Entire canvas opaque, no border, no transparency, no blank area, no text, labels or watermark.
prompts.keratin:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: opaque square albedo texture for Wolfos teeth and claws, replacing the attached original 8x8 texture in an Ocarina of Time styled remaster.
Create a FLAT material texture, not a tooth or claw object. Preserve the original UV layout: a continuous vertical value gradient with DARK ROOTS at the TOP and PALE IVORY TIPS at the BOTTOM. Top 10% near-black desaturated umber. From 10% to 35% transition through dark brown into muted horn tan. Middle is warm taupe and bone. Bottom 25% is pale aged ivory with restrained warm gray variation, not pure white. Gradient must vary smoothly across the full square, no hard horizontal bands. Fine parallel keratin growth fibers run vertically from top to bottom, with subtle streaks and small natural wear; no large chips, cracks or protrusions.
Style: finely hand-painted stylized game albedo, controlled details readable at 256px, consistent with the painted amber Wolfos eyes. No highlights or baked directional shadow, no cast shadow, no borders, no transparency, no standalone fangs, no mouth, no text, no black gaps. Fill the canvas. Keep the TOP DARK / BOTTOM LIGHT orientation exactly because the model maps nail roots and tips to those positions. Horizontal edges should tile smoothly.
prompts.nostril:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: opaque square painted single NOSTRIL albedo texture for the side of a stylized Wolfos muzzle. The attached native 8px texture is a placement/layout guide.
Paint a close-up flat texture of ONE recessed wolf nostril opening. Preserve the original layout: a near-black, subtly curved teardrop-shaped opening occupies the center-right of the square, running diagonally from lower-left toward upper-right; a rounded charcoal nose-leather rim lies on the upper-left side of the opening. The opening is deep black. Use subdued cool gray and muted umber along the curved rim, with a soft lighter upper-left edge and fine leathery pores. Keep the edges and corners of the square uniformly almost-black charcoal, so it blends into the existing nose polygons. Make the rim definition readable without a bright white highlight.
Style: restrained hand-painted game material, compatible with Zelda's angular creatures and the new amber painted eyes. This is texture artwork for ONE side of a 3D nose: do not draw a whole nose, a pair of nostrils, a face or fur. No checkerboard, no borders, no text, no perspective render, no wet photographic shine. Entire canvas opaque.
prompts.mouth:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: opaque square mouth-interior UV texture for the original Wolfos mesh. The attached native 8x8 map is the exact layout guide. Create FLAT texture artwork, not a mouth or creature rendering.
Preserve the original feature placement: on a muted dark brick-red gum field there are THREE small tapered worn-ivory tooth marks in a vertical column around x=45% of the canvas, centered at y=20%, y=45%, and y=70%. Each tooth mark occupies roughly 18% canvas width and 9% canvas height, fading through warm bone at its root into the gum; the teeth are short pointed incisors, not big fangs. Keep generous gum space around them. The LEFT edge stays dark muted reddish brown. The RIGHT third and bottom-right corner grade gradually to almost black burgundy to imply the mouth interior. Maintain those placements since this image wraps around a native mesh.
Hand-painted stylized game material: subtle gum grain and restrained leathery folds, softly rounded ivory teeth, no pixel blocks. Rich low-saturation oxblood/maroon rather than orange or fluorescent red. No wet shine, no gore, no drips, no full rows of human teeth, no lips, no face, no frame, no text. Entire square opaque, no transparency.

tongue.attempted_prompt:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: opaque square tongue albedo UV texture for a stylized Wolfos creature. The attached native 8x8 map is a layout guide, not a pixel-art style reference.
Paint only a flat color/material map with muted dusty rose and subdued mauve in the upper-left and upper-middle. Shade gradually into dark burgundy downwards and toward the right; the bottom-right quarter is almost black. The main lighter tongue surface occupies the upper-left two-thirds and has a soft shallow central groove and very subtle fine organic grain. Smooth painterly transitions, no square pixel bands, no neon pink. Preserve the original broad light-top-left / dark-bottom-right placement because this is mapped onto an existing mesh.
Polished hand-painted fantasy-game texture, readable at 256px, compatible with a gray-brown furred Zelda-style enemy. No tongue silhouette, no cutout, no lips, no teeth, no saliva, no gory detail, no wet highlights, no scene, no text, no frame. Entire square opaque and filled.
